fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics stock adjusted from its June high of 374,500 won to the 200,000 won range (intraday low of 204,500 won) in mid-October and is currently probing direction around 210,000 won.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 provisional results show revenue of approximately KRW 195 trillion and operating profit of KRW 107.4 trillion (operating margin 55%), marking the first time quarterly operating profit exceeded KRW 100 trillion; broker target prices range from 270,000 to 670,000 won with significant variance.
fields.summary_ko.2: Conservative camp (BNK 270,000 won) cites concerns over softer memory demand and oversupply, while optimistic camp (Nomura 670,000 won, KB 600,000 won) focuses on HBM4 profitability expansion and foundry yield recovery.
